buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Accounts Officer (Cash), O/o The CCA, WB Circle payable at Kolkata . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Accounts Officer (Cash), O/o The CCA, WB Circle . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 6. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders must be registered in the state of West Bengal and must have a local office in Kolkata. 1.1. As proof of registration in West Bengal, any one of the following documents may be submitted such as Proprietorship / Partnership/Pvt. Ltd./Public Ltd./GST registration/ITR etc. 1.2. For proof of a local office in Kolkata, acceptable documents include: electricity bill, rent agreement, Pr oprietorship / Partnership /Pvt. Ltd./Public Ltd./GST registration etc. [The geographical boundary of "Kolkat a" shall encompass the entire Kolkata Metropolitan Area (KMA), as notified by the Government of West Be ngal, applicable as on the date of bid publication. The valid documentary evidence of an office located any where within the KMA will be accepted as fulfilling this criterion.] 2. Bidders must thoroughly read the complete Scope of Work (attached in the bid document). Bidders must fill in the indicative quantity and brand of materials to be supplied along with a declaration stating that the y have read and understood the complete Scope of Work as per Annexure A. The Scope of Work document must be signed by the bidder on each page and submitted along with the bid. Failure to submit the signed Scope of Work and the declaration will result in summary rejection of the bid. 3. The pre-bid meeting is scheduled to provide bidders with clarifications, address questions, and ensure a clear understanding of the work requirements. The schedule for the pre-bid meeting is provided in the bid document. Bidders are encouraged to attend either in person or via video conference. To join the meeting online, please send an email request on “ad1.wb-dgt-dot@gov.in” by 5PM on the day prior to the schedule d meeting to receive the video conference link. 4. The bidder must provide at least 4 personnel for cleaning and sanitation services in the office and One d edicated manpower should be available during office hour so as to clean any office space/toilets, common area, disposal of garbage from dustbins on call basis immediately. The deployed manpower should not be changed frequently to ensure proper cleaning and to avoid repeat instructions. 5. In every billing cycle, the service provider must submit a certificate confirming that no amount has been collected from the deployed personnel in relation to their posting. 6. Vacuum cleaning of the area shall be performed using high-end machinery from reputed brands machin es such as Eureka Forbes, Karcher, Dyson, or equivalent. The contractor is required to submit a certificate confirming the completion of vacuum cleaning along with the monthly bill. 7. All the area shall be mopped using motorized microfiber spin mops. 8. The contractor shall bear the cost of any damages incurred and will be responsible for repairing or repla cing the affected items. 9. As per the terms of GeM Contract the performance of the cleaning work to be rated weekly and deductio ns (if applicable) will be done from the bill accordingly. 10. Only those bidders who qualify in the technical evaluation stage will have their Financial Bids opened. 11. Bidders must not share their IP address with other bidders or use another bidder’s IP address while par ticipating in the bid on GeM. If two or more bids are found to have the same IP address, all such bids will b e considered non-responsive and summarily rejected.

. 9. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 10. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 11. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service.
